messages.context: Sam 在私人岛屿首次自我介绍
messages.text: Excuse my manners, my name is Sam and I live next door... or should I rather say next "island".
messages.gloss: Sam 是 NPC 人名；island 的引号是空岛邻居的双关。
messages.zh: 请原谅我没先自我介绍,我叫 Sam,就住在隔壁……或者该说隔壁的“岛”上。

messages.context: 称赞玩家种植作物的才能
messages.text: You seem to have quite a talent for growing crops... which is something I couldn't really say about myself...
messages.zh: 看来你很有种植作物的天赋……我自己可完全谈不上……

messages.context: 说明自己经营继承来的农场遇到困难
messages.text: You see, I've been having quite the struggle with my farm that I inherited from my father.
messages.zh: 你看,我一直不太会打理父亲留给我的农场。

messages.text: He was a very skillful farmer... not like me... I have two left thumbs when it comes to farming.
messages.gloss: two left thumbs 表示笨手笨脚，不按字面翻译。
messages.zh: 他曾是个非常熟练的农夫……不像我……我干起农活来总是笨手笨脚。

messages.context: 犹豫地请求玩家帮助农场
messages.text: I was wondering if maybe you could... help me out... with my farm.
messages.zh: 我在想,也许你能……帮帮我……打理农场。

messages.context: 玩家拒绝帮助后的回应
再次询问玩家能否帮助农场
messages.text: Could you help me out with my farm?

messages.context: 玩家选了 [YES] 答应帮忙
messages.raw: Wow!! Thank you so much. I'll bring you right there.
messages.text: Wow!! Thank you so much. I'll bring you right there.
messages.zh: 哇!! 太感谢你了。我这就带你过去。

messages.text: Hmmm, it seems we can't go to The Garden right now. Let's try again later...
messages.zh: 嗯……现在好像去不了花园。待会儿再试试吧……

messages.context: Interacting after cleaning the first Garden Plot

身份: 继承父亲农场的花园助手,玩家的邻居。
关系: 起初求助,随后与玩家一起学习经营花园。
口吻: 犹豫而真诚,熟悉后兴奋亲切。
性格: 不自信却热心,爱分享。
禁用: 不贬低玩家,不把管理台和谷仓混淆;沿用花园旧对白。
